video_title: Hawks vs. Lakers Postgame Press Conference: Head Coach Quin Snyder

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on Hawks' lack of precision and carelessness
quotes.excerpt: most of it was we were careless or not precise
quotes.quote: Most of it was we were careless or not precise. Lack of precision, whether it be our spacing or not ball-facing and trying to make interior passes. They're really good at turning you over and they convert, and those are things that I think we understand, we just didn't execute in those ways. It's tough to defend against live-ball turnovers.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder says the Hawks were careless and lacked precision against the Lakers, noting that it is tough to defend against live ball turnovers.

structured.context: Head coach Quin Snyder discusses the team's lack of precision and high turnover rate during the postgame press conference against the Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on Hawks' late-game execution and spacing
quotes.excerpt: some of those possessions late were similar to the ones we had early
quotes.quote: Some of those possessions late were similar to the ones we had early, where there's opportunities to attack. We may not have been challenging people at the rim, opposed to thrusting through. It's really consistent with the whole game, whether it be us having poor spacing and trying to attack into a crowd. It's hard to do when they're all shifted and they're a heavy, heavy shifting team. There are opportunities to cut, all those things, but we have to be more connected collectively late in the game as well.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder on the Hawks late game struggles: We have to be more connected collectively and avoid attacking into a crowd against a heavy shifting team.

structured.context: Quin Snyder explains the Hawks' struggles with spacing and late-game execution against the Lakers' defensive shifting.

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on mental fatigue and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: it's hard to win when you have those lapses and you're trying to overcome the stakes
quotes.quote: I don't know if you can attribute it to any one thing, but I know it's hard to win when you have those lapses and you're trying to overcome the stakes. You know, we don't give ourselves. I thought we defended well early, but over the course of the game, they're going to make some shots. But there were also situations where we didn't get a chance to defend, and I think that was the part that really hurt us. I mean, they're the most efficient offense in the league. You know that going in, you're going to give something up. Luka is going to find people, but we shot ourselves in the foot a little bit with the turnovers.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder admits the Hawks shot themselves in the foot with turnovers: It is hard to win when you have those lapses and do not give yourselves a chance to defend.

structured.context: Quin Snyder reflects on the team's turnovers and the difficulty of defending against the league's most efficient offense.

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on defending Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: he's a terrific player and in order to guard him effectively there's times we have to commit
quotes.quote: He's a terrific player and in order to guard him effectively there's times we have to commit two people to the ball, and he's a willing passer too. So sometimes when the ball came out of the trap, it put more pressure on our defense to rotate properly, and that's what those other guys thrive on, their ability to attack closeouts and rotations. He hit some shots that he's going to hit. I thought there were a couple times you could feel him kind of get it going, but by and large, we were solid.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder on the challenge of guarding Luka Doncic: When the ball comes out of the trap it puts pressure on our defense to rotate properly and that is what their other guys thrive on.

structured.context: Quin Snyder discusses the defensive strategy used to contain Luka Doncic and the resulting pressure on the Hawks' rotation.

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on defending the Lakers' shift with Christian Wood
quotes.excerpt: there were a couple times early where we were out of position
quotes.quote: There were a couple times early where we were out of position. He's so big, you have to really be there early. And when he gets the ball, I'm higher on the floor, you know he's usually looking to pass. The times that he got late, or they found him late when he was low, it's harder for us to handle with that level of size. But I thought, giving up, you can't give up and ones, and I thought there were too many positions there where we have to make a merit from the foul line. That's, you pull in early, you're going to be rotating out of it, and that's, you know, typically our, in order to protect the rim, we have to really protect the paint.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder says the Hawks struggled to handle the size of Christian Wood when they were out of position and gave up too many and ones.

structured.context: Quin Snyder analyzes the defensive challenges posed by Christian Wood's size and the team's failure to prevent and-ones.

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on half-court defense and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: you can't play well enough defensively in the half court to overcome numbers situations when we turn
quotes.quote: You can't play well enough defensively in the half court to overcome numbers situations when we turn the ball over. Okay.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder says you cannot play well enough defensively in the half court to overcome the numbers situations created by turnovers.

structured.context: Quin Snyder summarizes the team's inability to compensate for turnovers with half-court defensive play.
